title: InstallationView
description: `GET /engines/claude/installation`: "why does Claude not work here?" Never fails because the CLI did not answer: every part says what it could read and why not (plan 13, B-11).

bundledCli.description: The binary the SDK spawns, from its manifest.

pathCli.description: The `claude` on `PATH`, when there is one — often another version. Mirrors `ReadVersion` plus `differs`, inlined because the generator refuses any sibling beside a `$ref` (plan 28, B-48).

differs.description: Whether the version on `PATH` differs from the bundled one.

configDir.description: The configuration directory the CLI reads: `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, or `~/.claude` without it.

login.description: What the last answer of the installation said of the login — `unknown` before any.

lastModelCheck.description: The test of the connection most recently run, by user. `null` before any.
